{"consolidated_memory":"PLAN DRIFT IN VPC MODULE - TWO SEPARATE INCIDENTS

File: infra/terraform/vpc.tf (infrastructure side)
Stack: HCL, Covering check: terraform plan check in CI
Common symptom across both incidents: diff on a resource nobody edited after running plan twice with no changes in between

INCIDENT 1 [2026-01-27]:
- Root cause: floating point rounding in the money path
- Fix: moved arithmetic to integer minor units (PR #8605, branch fix/plan-drift-1)
- Result: memory settled at 532 MB instead of climbing past 4 GB
- Discovery context: turned up after rolling restart of the fleet

INCIDENT 2 [2026-08-19]:
- Root cause: unbounded retry loop with no backoff
- Fix: capped attempts and added exponential backoff with jitter (PR #9251, branch fix/plan-drift-2)
- Result: backlog cleared 55 minutes after the deploy
- Discovery context: turned up after client had already retried once"}
